reader_summary.headline: This is Zack Fuss, an investor at Irenic Capital, and today we’re breaking down the vertical market software business, Toast.
reader_summary.overview: This is Zack Fuss, an investor at Irenic Capital, and today we’re breaking down the vertical market software business, Toast. Toast is a software platform built specifically for restaurants. Their operating system gives restauranteurs all the tools they need to serve customers, from taking orders to allocating shifts.

key_points.text: It was founded in 2011 and went public a decade later.
Today, it’s used by nearly 80,000 restaurants across the US.
To breakdown Toast, I’m joined by Will Schreiber, the co-founder and CEO of Bottle – an ecommerce platform built for subscription businesses.
